comments.author: mathbunnyru
comments.body:
This is most likely not a bug - this project doesn't build for all the versions of all the packages used in images - that's impossible.
Instead, we only build images weekly automatically and when some PR changes some images (we also rebuild everything).

4.1.6 tag happened Jul 31: https://github.com/jupyterhub/jupyterhub/releases/tag/4.1.6
5.1.0 tag also happened Jul 31: https://github.com/jupyterhub/jupyterhub/releases/tag/5.1.0
So it's very likely that there were no conflicts with the newer version, and it was chosen automatically by `mamba`'s resolver.

Now, let's talk about the issue you have.
You want to use `jupyterhub` version `4.1.6` (which is fine).
The easiest way to do it is to find the image that works well for you except jupyterhub and a few other things, then install the needed version.
Here is an example: https://jupyter-docker-stacks.readthedocs.io/en/latest/using/recipes.html#using-mamba-install-recommended-or-pip-install-in-a-child-docker-image (there is no pinned version in an example, but you can use `mamba install jupyterhub=4.1.6`)

Hope this helps. If it doesn't, please, reopen the issue.
